method.baseline: Same source snapshot with this task’s gerund changes removed; other concurrent changes preserved.
method.sources: Cached and recorded public Wiktionary pages merged by title; recorded inflection, frequency and entity responses reused by request hash. Missing responses stayed missing. Three Russian raw pages were verified live using the required generic User-Agent.
method.execution: Temporary source copies with stub fetch; request pacing disabled only in those copies. Runtime fetch.mjs unchanged.
method.selection: Seven task examples, twelve seeded website suffix candidates (including non-gerund controls), two selected website sentences; separate 30 website sentences from sample.mjs sentence 30 20261104.
method.limits: Completeness means parser/render coverage, not translation quality. Missing lexical responses and existing sense/parse problems limit these controlled runs.
